name: BizAutomation Cloud ERP
description_en:
BizAutomation is a hosted ERP aimed at wholesale distribution and discrete manufacturing. The documented product joins sales orders, purchasing, warehouse allocation, production and financial records, with configuration and automation around those transactions.

A single-edition architecture does not mean every extension or hosting option is included. Pricing distinguishes a ten-user baseline, additional users, resource overages, dedicated environments and named add-ons. This research did not run the ERP or verify its AI, performance or implementation-outcome claims.
description_zh:
BizAutomation 是面向批发分销和离散制造的托管 ERP。资料将销售订单、采购、仓库分配、生产及财务记录相连，并围绕交易提供配置和自动化。

采用单版本架构不等于所有扩展或托管方式都包含在内。定价区分十用户基础额度、额外用户、资源超额、独立环境及命名附加项。本文未运行 ERP，也未验证 AI、性能或实施效果主张。

core_features.explanation_en: The order product describes quotes, contract pricing, sales orders, fulfillment and accounting in one flow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 订单产品介绍报价、合同定价、销售订单、履约和会计流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Manufacturing describes multilevel BOMs, work orders, routings, MRP and work-in-progress costing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 制造产品介绍多层物料清单、工单、工艺路线、MRP 及在制品成本。

core_features.explanation_en: The product describes blocking or approving quotes/orders below configured margin thresholds.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品介绍对低于配置毛利阈值的报价或订单阻止或发起审批。

sections.title_en: Trace the order and its fulfillment obligations
sections.en:
The order page describes quote-to-order conversion, contract pricing, warehouse allocation, vendor purchase orders and fulfillment. It distinguishes dropshipping, blind-shipping documents and customer-specific pricing from a simple retail checkout. Those workflows may be relevant when one customer order depends on multiple suppliers or locations.

For a hypothetical distributor, split an order between warehouse stock and a supplier-direct line. Follow the purchase order, shipment reference, customer invoice and ledger effects for each line. Then process a partial return. This is an editorial evaluation scenario; the research did not establish the actual document sequence, connector setup or financial result in an account.
sections.zh:
订单页面介绍报价转订单、合同定价、仓库分配、供应商采购单及履约，并把直发、隐藏供货方的发运单据和客户专属定价与简单零售结账区分开来。如果一张客户订单依赖多个供应商或地点，这些流程值得检查。

以假设的分销商为例，把一张订单分为仓库现货和供应商直发两部分，逐行追踪采购订单、发运参考、客户发票和总账影响，再处理部分退货。这是编辑评估场景，本文未在账户内确立实际单据顺序、连接器配置或财务结果。

sections.title_en: Production needs component, route and cost evidence
sections.title_zh: 生产需要组件、路线和成本证据
sections.en:
The manufacturing page describes discrete assemblies with nested BOMs, workstation steps, material reservations, work orders, capacity scheduling and WIP/finished-goods accounting. It also describes configure-to-order rules generating product structures and routings from an approved configuration. These claims are about assembled products; do not turn them into verified process-industry support.

A representative test could build one configured item from two components, record labor and scrap, and compare planned versus actual cost. Also test a missing component and an approved substitution. Those are proposed acceptance cases. The public page does not prove that your engineering revisions, finite-capacity constraints or quality procedures have been configured correctly.
sections.zh:
制造页介绍离散组装中的嵌套物料清单、工位步骤、物料预留、工单、产能排程，以及在制品和成品会计；还介绍按配置生产规则，可从批准的配置生成产品结构和路线。它们针对组装产品，不能转换成已核实的流程工业支持。

可测试用两个组件生产一个配置物品，记录人工及报废，并比较计划与实际成本，再检查组件缺失和获批准替代。这些属于建议验收；公开页面不能证明自身工程版本、有限产能约束或质量程序已经配置正确。

sections.title_en: Read the ten-user base and the extensions together
sections.title_zh: 同时核对十用户基础费和扩展
sections.en:
The pricing page read on 22 October 2026 states $999 per month for ten users plus $99.95 for each additional user. A nearby per-user label refers to a one-year term. The dollar display does not independently establish an ISO currency here, and the contract/payment term should be confirmed. For an illustrative twelve-user baseline, $999 + 2 × $99.95 equals $1,198.90 before other charges.

The same page lists resource overages and extensions including Data-Mirror, intelligent document processing, logistics, commerce and tax services. Dedicated hosting is quoted separately and requires Data-Mirror in its displayed conditions. A single edition therefore does not justify saying all capabilities are included without extra cost. Implementation scope also requires a proposal.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的定价页写明，十用户每月 $999，额外每用户 $99.95；旁边的每用户标签提及一年期限。本次不只凭 $ 符号确立 ISO 币种，合同和付款期限也需确认。以十二用户基础额度为算例，$999 + 2 × $99.95 = $1,198.90，尚未计其他费用。

同页还列出资源超额，以及 Data-Mirror、智能单据处理、物流、电商和税务服务等扩展。独立托管另行报价，所列条件还要求 Data-Mirror。因此单版本不能支持“所有能力均无需加价”的说法，实施范围也需要方案。

sections.title_en: Configuration and AI still need controlled exceptions
sections.title_zh: 配置及 AI 仍需受控异常
sections.en:
The website describes margin thresholds, approval routing, invoice/PO document extraction and an AI orchestration offering based on Data-Mirror. It uses absolute claims about preventing hallucinations and database corruption. This profile records advertised scope but does not adopt those guarantees as independently verified facts.

Before relying on a generated order or bill, show an ambiguous document, a below-floor price, a changed supplier bank account and a duplicate submission. Inspect what is proposed, what can commit, who approves and what evidence is retained. These are test suggestions. Permission checks, failure handling, transaction safety and actual AI accuracy were not executed or audited here.
sections.zh:
网站介绍毛利阈值、审批流转、发票与采购单资料提取，以及基于 Data-Mirror 的 AI 编排，还使用避免幻觉及数据库损坏的绝对表述。本文记录其宣传范围，不将这些保证当成独立核实事实。

依赖自动生成订单或账单前，可演示模糊单据、低于底价、供应商银行变更和重复提交，检查系统提出什么、能提交什么、谁批准及保留哪些证据。这些只是测试建议；本文未执行或审计权限、失败处理、事务安全或 AI 准确性。

sections.title_en: Implement one operational loop before widening scope
sections.title_zh: 先实施一条完整业务闭环
sections.en:
Prepare items/units, warehouses, customer/vendor records, pricing and margin rules, BOMs/routes, opening balances and approval ownership. The vendor describes partner-led implementation with architectural oversight and multi-tenant versus dedicated managed hosting. That does not establish your migration, uptime, backup or cancellation terms.

The system is worth investigating for a distributor or discrete producer with those connected requirements. A small invoice-only workflow may not justify the breadth or ten-user starting commitment. Ask for data export and a separate-environment restore demonstration, plus contract terms for custom development and integrations. No source-code redistribution right, permanent free plan or tested reliability conclusion was established.
sections.zh:
先准备物品单位、仓库、客户供应商、价格毛利规则、物料路线、期初余额和审批责任。厂商描述由伙伴实施并提供架构跟进，以及多租户和独立托管，但这些不能确立自身迁移、可用性、备份或取消条件。

具有这些关联需求的分销商或离散制造商可以评估；简单开票流程可能无需该广度及十用户起始投入。应取得数据导出和独立环境恢复演示，并明确定制开发和集成合同。本次未确立源码再分发权、永久免费套餐或经测试的可靠性结论。
